analysis.rationale: R1 re-ran full analysis on all 5 support pairs and independently re-verified the R0 control. Every pair yields PSNR=inf with 0% deviation in all 10 CI metrics, so the deterministic pipeline blur_gaussian:3 -> brightness_brighten_shfit_RGB:1 -> compression_jpeg:4 is exact for this scenario. Signal reinterpretation resolves the R0 conflict points: (1) the raw-residual noise verdict GAUSSIAN_YCrCb is a false positive - noise_prior sigma swings 0.74-4.08 across content for a fixed degradation and the peeled residual after stripping the deterministic chain is exactly zero (channel std 0.0) on all 5 pairs, so the 100% extreme_pct is a zero-residual division artifact, not impulse noise; (2) the blur DT subtype flips between motion (pair0, anisotropy 2.29) and glass (pairs1-4, glass_score 1.23-1.46) at low confidence, i.e., content/JPEG-grid-driven false positives; gaussian:3 is confirmed by the bit-exact match; (3) full_analysis masks brightness as 'brightness_from_jpeg', but mean_shift is +24.4..+24.9 on all five pairs (matches shift sev1 = 25.5), so the global step is real and the variance_ratio 0.63-0.85 is blur+JPEG variance loss, not contrast; (4) gamma-suspect (residual_intensity_corr -0.17..-0.37) is excluded: the additive uniform shift reproduces exactly while brightness_brighten_gamma_RGB:1 only reaches 25.73 dB.
